# method.md

## Launch (scripts/benchmark_runner/runtime.py)
- `command()` computes `limit = remaining_seconds(timeout or 86400)` from module `DEADLINE`; raises `TimeoutError` if exhausted.
- Uses `subprocess.Popen(args, cwd=REPO, stdout=PIPE, stderr=STDOUT, text=True, start_new_session=True)`.
- Waits via `process.communicate(timeout=limit)`.

## Timeout cleanup (runtime.py)
- On `subprocess.TimeoutExpired`: observed `os.killpg(process.pid, SIGTERM)`; ignores `ProcessLookupError`.
- Then `communicate(timeout=5)`; if still running, `os.killpg(process.pid, SIGKILL)`; then final `communicate()`.
- Raises `subprocess.TimeoutExpired(args, limit, output=output)`.
- `cleanup_budget()` context sets global `DEADLINE = time.monotonic() + 180`, restores prior value.

## Receipts (runtime.py)
- `write_json()` writes temp file in target dir, flush, `os.fsync`, `replace`, `unlink(missing_ok=True)`.

## Checkpoint policy (checkpoints.py)
- Module docstring: "Atomic, identity-bound successful unit receipts; failures always rerun."
- `read_checkpoint()` checks identity and `sha256_json(row)`; `reusable()` re-evaluates unit.
- `save_checkpoint()` writes identity/sha256/row through `write_json`.

## Docker entry (docker/benchmark/openviking.Dockerfile)
- Observed `CMD ["python3", "/opt/benchmark/benchmark-unit.py", "--target", "openviking"]`.

# method.md
Sources: scripts/benchmark_runner/runtime.py, scripts/benchmark_runner/checkpoints.py, makefiles/format.toml, rust-toolchain.toml, docker/benchmark/openviking.Dockerfile.

## Observed lifecycle (runtime.py)
DEADLINE global; remaining_seconds(maximum) returns min(maximum, DEADLINE - monotonic), raises TimeoutError if <=0. cleanup_budget saves/sets DEADLINE = now+180s then restores.
command(args, *, env=None, check=True, timeout=None): limit = remaining_seconds(timeout if not None else 86400). Popen(args, cwd=REPO, env=env, stdout=PIPE, stderr=STDOUT, text=True, start_new_session=True). communicate(timeout=limit).
Timeout path: os.killpg(process.pid, SIGTERM), swallowing ProcessLookupError; communicate(timeout=5); if still TimeoutExpired, os.killpg(process.pid, SIGKILL) swallowing ProcessLookupError; communicate(); raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(args, limit, output=output) from None. Return CompletedProcess; check calls check_returncode.

## Checkpoint workflow (checkpoints.py)
read_checkpoint(path, identity, suite, target): missing -> None. load_json; validate record["identity"] and record["sha256"] == sha256_json(row); reusable(row, suite, target). reusable calls evaluate_unit and integrity_findings; KeyError/TypeError/ValueError -> False. Reused row gets reuse note: "Prior measurement; not a fresh timing sample." save_checkpoint uses write_json {"identity", "sha256", "row"}.
Policy/docstring: "Atomic, identity-bound successful unit receipts; failures always rerun."

## Related inputs
makefiles/format.toml: fmt depends fmt-rust, fmt-toml; check-format mirrors; toml uses git ls-files with taplo. rust-toolchain.toml: stable, minimal, clippy. Dockerfile builds pinned OpenViking revision, uv sync --frozen --no-editable; CMD benchmark-unit.py --target openviking.

# Method
## Observed receipt reuse (scripts/benchmark_runner/checkpoints.py)
- save_checkpoint writes {identity, sha256: sha256_json(row), row} via runtime.write_json.
- read_checkpoint returns None if missing, identity mismatch, sha256 mismatch, or reusable() false.
- reusable() re-runs evaluate_unit on row['unit_result'] with suite/target; rejects if fresh != row['evaluation'] or integrity_findings reports any finding; catches KeyError/TypeError/ValueError.
- On success, row gets reuse={reused:true, original_receipt: resolved path, note:'Prior measurement; not a fresh timing sample.'}. Failures always rerun.

## Runtime boundary (scripts/benchmark_runner/runtime.py)
- write_json is atomic: tempfile .receipt-* in target dir, fsync, Path.replace, cleanup.
- command() enforces remaining_seconds deadline, starts new session, kills process group SIGTERM then SIGKILL on timeout.
- cleanup_budget() sets DEADLINE to now+180s temporarily.
- source_fingerprint() records git HEAD, dirty flag, status sha256, content sha256 over diff and untracked files.

## Policy configs
- makefiles/format.toml: fmt/check-format pair; Rust via rustup nightly cargo fmt; Toml via taplo over git ls-files.
- rust-toolchain.toml: stable, clippy, minimal.
- docker/benchmark/openviking.Dockerfile: pinned OPENVIKING_REVISION; copies scripts/benchmark-unit.py and benchmark_targets; CMD runs target openviking.

j_e79d92fc2bf7fca41b742f2d.notes/method.md:
## Checkpoints (scripts/benchmark_runner/checkpoints.py)
- Receipt = {identity, sha256(row), row}; save_checkpoint writes atomically via runtime.write_json.
- read_checkpoint returns row only if path exists, identity and sha256 match, and reusable(row,suite,target). reusable re-evaluates with benchmark_contract.evaluate_unit(suite,row.unit_result,target); must equal row.evaluation and have no integrity_findings. On success it adds row.reuse={reused:true, original_receipt:resolved path, note:"Prior measurement; not a fresh timing sample."}. Comment: atomic, identity-bound successful unit receipts; failures always rerun.

## Runtime (scripts/benchmark_runner/runtime.py)
- write_json writes temp file in target dir, fsyncs, Path.replace, unlinks temp.
- command uses global DEADLINE via remaining_seconds; start_new_session; timeout kills process group SIGTERM then SIGKILL, raises TimeoutExpired. cleanup_budget sets DEADLINE=monotonic+180 in context. source_fingerprint records git HEAD, dirty status, status_sha256, content_sha256 over diff and untracked files.

## Policy (makefiles/format.toml, rust-toolchain.toml)
- fmt/check-format share scope: rustup nightly cargo fmt --all; taplo fmt/--check over git ls-files -z --cached --others --exclude-standard -- '*.toml'.
- rust-toolchain.toml: stable, clippy, minimal.

## Docker benchmark image (docker/benchmark/openviking.Dockerfile)
- Pins OPENVIKING_REVISION; fetch depth=1, checkout detach, verify HEAD; uv sync --frozen --no-editable; writes REVISION; copies scripts/benchmark-unit.py and scripts/benchmark_targets; CMD benchmark-unit.py --target openviking.
